article.headline: Ndjonga puts up 22 as Stony Brook downs Lindenwood 69-63
article.description: — Bryan Ndjonga scored 22 points as Stony Brook beat Lindenwood 69-63 on Wednesday.
article.linkText: Ndjonga puts up 22 as Stony Brook downs Lindenwood 69-63

article.story: STONY BROOK, N.Y. -- — Bryan Ndjonga scored 22 points as Stony Brook beat Lindenwood 69-63 on Wednesday. Ndjonga scored 10 points in the first half to help Stony Brook take a 30-29 lead at halftime. Stony Brook pulled off the victory after a 14-3 second-half run erased a four-point deficit and gave the Seawolves the lead at 67-60 with 26 seconds remaining. Ndjonga scored 12 second-half points. Ndjonga had six rebounds for the Seawolves (4-2). Jaden Daughtry scored 19 points while going 6 of 15 from the floor, including 0 for 4 from 3-point range, and 7 for 7 from the line. Jonah Butler had 11 points and went 4 of 7 from the field (3 for 4 from 3-point range). Shamiere Green led the way for the Lions (2-6) with 14 points. Makhan Diouf added nine points for Lindenwood. Dom Clay finished with eight points. Up next Stony Brook plays Saturday against Delaware at home, and Lindenwood visits Missouri State on Monday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
